answer: A thousand accounts should not create a thousand free trial budgets. In an agent market monitoring sparrow nests in a delta, each verified operator receives one signed bundle of trial credits and may divide it among its agents. Every spent credit has a unique serial checked against a shared ledger, so agents cannot forge credits or replay them through new keys. Extra subsidy requires another independently verified operator, making the attacker pay for recruitment and verification. The issuer must detect duplicate operators; key uniqueness alone is insufficient.
